summary: Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (100%). Frontend: end-to-end web flow works — register/login, dashboard with 4 form cards + history, header → samples (jalur/titik dropdown + segmented) → signature (web placeholder as expected) → submit → history entry created → detail screen with PDF/Excel/Share WA buttons all render. Exports return valid application/pdf and xlsx. Cross-user isolation verified (404 for other user's inspection). Minor: duplicated `history-<id>` testID on dashboard row causes Playwright strict-mode click issue on the outer wrapper (functional on real mobile touch; workaround: use JS click or navigate by URL).

ui_bugs.issue: Two DOM elements share the same data-testid="history-<id>" (react-native-web renders both the Pressable wrapper and inner container with the same testID). Playwright strict-mode locator .first().click() reports 'element is not visible' on the outer wrapper. Not a real user-facing bug on native. Consider giving the outer Pressable a distinct testID such as `history-row-<id>` OR removing testID from the inner container.

'Inspeksi tersimpan' toast overlays the top of the dashboard history row for ~4-5s after submit and blocks taps on the first history row until dismissed. Consider auto-hide after 2s or positioning at the bottom.

action_items: (optional) Assign unique testID to the outer Pressable vs inner View for history rows to remove duplicates in DOM, e.g., testID=`history-row-<id>` on outer Pressable.
(optional) Shorten the success toast auto-hide (~1.5-2s) or move it to bottom to avoid overlapping the newly created history entry.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 590 lines, still readable but approaching the 700-line split threshold; could split auth/upload/inspections/export into modules.
GET /api/files uses ONLY ?token= query auth (no header fallback) — fine for tags but reject-only if token missing is correct.
seed_data_creation: Test users created via /api/auth/register with random emails (qc.tester+*, qc.ui+*, qc.flow+*, qc.det*+*, qc.api+*) — soft-deleted inspections and unused users remain in MongoDB (not blocking; test data is prefixed and easily identifiable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Tests: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0. Frontend web preview: register via UI, then Land Clearing form has header-* testIDs, samples step has jalur-0 / titik-0 dropdowns with jalur-0-opt-<num> / titik-0-opt-<num> options, next-samples/next-signature/submit-inspection buttons. Detail screen: export-pdf, export-excel, export-wa testIDs.
